prayerExcerpt.en-US: Pierce my heart with the arrow of Thy love.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Traspassai meu coração com a seta do vosso amor.

meta.face: A woman of about forty with a STRONG, HEART-SHAPED face — a high, broad, rounded forehead, straight, strongly marked dark brows nearly level, deep-set dark brown eyes, a long, straight, fine nose, high cheekbones narrowing to a small, pointed chin, a wide, thin-lipped mouth set in a composed line; warm olive-toned skin; hair hidden under the wimple and veil; a steady, intelligent, scholarly gaze looking level toward the viewer (NOT upturned, not girlish, not doll-like).
meta.basis: Nothing is known of her looks; the face is an artistic choice for a nun near forty (she died at 46). The iconography is the Baroque one: a nun in the black Benedictine habit with the ample cowl sleeves and a burning heart with the Christ Child on her breast; the crozier, which belongs to her abbess Gertrude of Hackeborn, is left out.
meta.excerpt: Gertrude, The Herald of Divine Love II.5, in The Life and Revelations of Saint Gertrude (Burns & Oates / Benziger, 1870s), p. 83: "I beseech Thee … to pierce my heart with the arrow of Thy love" (en-US verbatim, "to" dropped); pt-BR our rendering. No formulary for 11-16/gertrude in the repo
